data.displayName: Capital Business Rewards Gas - 10% off usage

fees.description: Disconnection fee - applicable when energy is disconnected to the property. Wasted site visit fee of $52.44 (gst incl) applies if work cannot be completed.
Reconnection fee - applicable when energy is reconnected to the property.  Wasted site visit fee of $134.51 (gst incl) applies if work cannot be completed.
Special meter read (including moving in and moving out of your supply address). Fee also applies for a wasted site visit to read the meter.
Late Payment Fee may be applied, if applicable (GST is not applicable).
Direct Debit Rejection Fee (GST is not applicable).
Payment processing fee may apply to payments made by credit card (GST inclusive). Not applicable after 1 October 2026.
Payment processing fee may apply to payments made by debit card (GST inclusive). Not applicable after 1 October 2026.

gasContract.terms: A copy of the Market Retail Contract is provided and can be seen on our website. Refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/legal/pricing-information/your-rights-and-obligations.

discounts.description: All customers will receive a 10% discount off their gas usage charges, applied to each quarterly gas invoice for a benefit period of 24 months. Discount does not apply to any miscellaneous fees and charges; and will not apply to any government taxes, fees, levies or charges. For further information, refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/NSW-Standard-gas-prices-July-2026.

gasContract.variation: If we vary our market offer prices or miscellaneous fees and charges, we will notify you at least five business days before the variation in the tariffs and charges are to apply to you; and deliver the notice by your preferred form of communication where you have communicated this to us, or otherwise by the same method as that used for delivery of your bill.

incentives.description: The Carbon Neutral Gas opt-in product offsets the emissions from your natural gas usage. Certified by Climate Active, you can opt-in for $1.50 per week inc. GST, applied to your natural gas account. For more information visit https://www.actewagl.com.au/sustainability/carbon-neutral-gas.

gasContract.onExpiryDescription: The benefit period is 2 years. At the end of your benefit period you may be placed on a new pricing plan. We will notify you of any changes at least 20 business days before they take effect.
gasContract.additionalFeeInformation: For information on additional fees, refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/legal/pricing-information/charges-and-rates.
